scope: Read-only features for all83 saved v8 paths and their exact saved ORS counterparts; no new graph/query/provider/key/env/DB read or candidate fitting.

corridor.measure: Length-weighted midpoint samples, nearest projected point on reference segments checked with haversine distance, both directions. Proximity is not road identity or area accuracy; outside-radius samples remain unmatched, never replaced.

features: NE and Census source-road/connector distances and paid minutes
NE connector distance per100 source-road km
descriptive correlations/cohorts by signed residual and set; all cases retained

counterfactualBasis.purpose: Report connector-only charging differences at the existing local25 and minimum-retained-road55 speeds; no new candidate ETA, road repricing or search. No sweep or accepted policy.

interpretation: Observed development paths can have different geometry/choices and repeated origins. No causal ETA decomposition, national inference, unseen holdout claim, region/coordinate/fixture exception or parameter optimization. Any new candidate needs its own frozen rule and prospective gates before production.
